name: challenge-4-city
description: The city handed out for the challenge run, and the default map. The small
practice track lives in config/city_practice.json. Transcribed from
config/challenge_graph_as_received.txt, which had three typos corrected here:
C port 3 was written '3,(B,1)', D's block ended with '.' instead of ',',
and I port 3 was written '(F:4)'. All three readings are confirmed by the
symmetry requirement -- every connection in this file has a matching
counterpart, which load_city() re-checks on startup.
9 intersections, 15 streets. A and B are joined twice (A1-B3 and A2-B2),
so the pair carries two distinct streets and therefore possibly two gates.
cyclically around an intersection, so 1 and 3 are opposite each other and 2
is always to the right of 1. A port that is absent has no street attached.
'nodes' maps node -> port -> [neighbour_node, neighbour_port] and must be
symmetric: if A port 1 leads to B port 3, then B port 3 leads back to A
The layout reads ports as compass directions (1 = N, 2 = W, 3 = S, 4 = E),
which 10 of the 15 streets agree on; the remaining five (A2-B2, C2-G2,
D4-H3, F4-I3, H1-I4) are streets that curve, so they are drawn as the
diagonals and offsets they end up as. The result is crossing-free.
